domain_rule: Reconstruct complete closed core-safe set inclisolated points. Letc=max(core),w=max positive component width,U=1/(4w). Exact real speed-domain D=(c,U] if U>c; otherwise D empty. No additional d range. For integer d>U, every phase leaves positive duration by width; handle analytically.

modes.F: Strict final blocking covers every closed core component including isolatedpoints; no full safe point in[0,1].

modes.Z: Closed final blocking covers every positive-length core component, equivalent to zero full safe duration; ignore isolatedcorepoints.
